skill.name: ckm-design-system
skill.description: Design-system toolkit for design tokens, component specifications, Tailwind-ready token output, token validation, and brand-compliant slide generation.
skill.summary: Build token-driven design systems and presentation assets with reusable validation and generation helpers.
skill.author: nextlevelbuilder

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, JavaScript template literals, CSV design vocabulary, dictionary key access, and fixed public resource URLs. Confirmed issues are local filesystem write/read risks in the token generator plus semantic risks in slide generation: unescaped HTML content and unrestricted output paths. No prompt-injection attempt was found in the reviewed skill files.

remediation.issue: Token generator accepts unrestricted config and output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and parent-directory traversal, or restrict reads and writes to approved project directories.

remediation.issue: Slide generator interpolates slide data directly into HTML.
remediation.suggestion: Escape text fields by default and allow raw HTML only through an explicit trusted-content option.

remediation.issue: Slide generator can write to arbitrary output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Default to a dedicated slides output directory and require confirmation for paths outside that directory.

remediation.issue: Generated slides may load third-party fonts, images, or CDN scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Document these dependencies and provide local or self-hosted options for privacy-sensitive users.

content.value_statement: Design systems drift when tokens, components, and presentation assets are handled separately. This skill provides token architecture, validators, and slide helpers for consistent implementation.
actual_capabilities: Explains a primitive, semantic, and component token architecture for design systems.
Generates CSS variables or Tailwind color configuration from token JSON files.
Validates source files and HTML assets for hardcoded colors, spacing, and font usage.
Searches slide strategy, layout, copy, chart, typography, and color CSV references.
Generates HTML slide decks from structured slide data and design-token CSS.
Provides curated Pexels background URLs and overlay CSS for presentation slides.
limitations: Several helpers read or write local files, so run them only inside trusted project directories.
Generated slides require the expected assets/design-tokens.css and assets/design-tokens.json files.
Slide HTML generation does not sanitize untrusted slide text by default.
External fonts, images, and optional Chart.js examples can load third-party resources when opened.

use_cases.title: Create a Token Architecture
use_cases.description: Define primitive, semantic, and component tokens before teams implement themes, states, and variants.

use_cases.title: Audit Token Compliance
use_cases.description: Scan local source files and HTML assets for hardcoded values that should use design tokens.

use_cases.title: Plan Branded Presentations
use_cases.description: Use slide strategy, layout, copy, chart, and background references to plan consistent presentation decks.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Token System
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new design system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ckm-design-system to outline primitive, semantic, and component tokens for a SaaS dashboard. Include color, typography, spacing, radius, and state tokens.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Existing UI
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate audit for a local frontend project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ckm-design-system to review my src directory for hardcoded design values. Summarize violations and suggest equivalent token categories.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Token Outputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ckm-design-system to convert my token JSON into CSS variables and a Tailwind color extension. Keep outputs inside the project assets directory.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Pitch Deck System
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ckm-design-system to plan a 10-slide investor deck with strategy, layout, typography, color treatment, chart choices, and token-compliant HTML output.

output_examples.input: Request a token plan for a dashboard product.
output: A three-layer token map covering raw values, semantic aliases, and component-specific tokens.
Recommended naming rules for colors, typography, spacing, shadows, and interaction states.

output_examples.input: Ask for a token compliance review of a frontend folder.
output: A local audit summary listing hardcoded colors, pixel values, and rem values.
Suggested replacements using color, spacing, radius, and typography token families.

output_examples.input: Ask for a branded presentation plan.
output: A slide-by-slide structure with recommended layouts, copy formulas, chart types, and emotional pacing.
Guidance for token-compliant slide styling and background image selection.

best_practices: Keep primitive values separate from semantic aliases and component tokens.
Run validators on trusted project folders before reviewing or sharing generated outputs.
Keep generated slides and token files in predictable asset directories.
anti_patterns: Do not paste untrusted HTML or scripts into slide data used for generation.
Do not run file-writing helpers with absolute paths or parent-directory traversal.
Do not mix raw hex values with token references in production components.

faq.question: Can this skill create a full design system?
faq.answer: It can provide token architecture, examples, validators, and generation helpers. It still needs product-specific design decisions and review.

faq.question: Does it support Tailwind?
faq.answer: Yes. The token generator can produce Tailwind color configuration from semantic token values.

faq.question: Can it validate my code automatically?
faq.answer: It includes local validators for source files and HTML assets. Review results before making changes.

faq.question: Can it generate slide decks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate HTML slide decks from structured slide data and token-based templates.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Most tooling is local. Generated slides or examples may reference Google Fonts, Pexels images, or Chart.js CDN resources.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted content?
faq.answer: Treat untrusted slide data carefully. The slide generator inserts text into HTML and should be sanitized before sharing.
